prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Vikram Y., Vikram bhai, Subhash bhai, Manoj bhai.
The chat covers 06/03/26, 7:15 pm to 06/03/26, 9:15 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
06/03/26, 8:27 pm - Vikram bhai: Manoj bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
text:
06/03/26, 7:15 pm - Subhash bhai: Aaj ki shop closing details spreadsheet me upload ho gayi kya?
06/03/26, 7:19 pm - Manoj bhai: Haan Subhash bhai, maine saare payment records add kar diye hain.
06/03/26, 7:24 pm - Vikram Y.: QR code se kitna collection hua aaj total?
06/03/26, 7:28 pm - Manoj bhai: Around 45,000 QR scanner se aaya hai.
06/03/26, 7:35 pm - Subhash bhai: Good, lekin ek 12,500 ka UPI payment pending dikha raha hai.
06/03/26, 7:41 pm - Vikram Y.: Wo customer phonepe screenshot dikha ke gaya tha na?
06/03/26, 7:46 pm - Manoj bhai: Haan, unhone bola account se debit ho gaya hai.
06/03/26, 7:52 pm - Subhash bhai: Par hamare bank app me money credit nahi hua abhi tak.
06/03/26, 7:58 pm - Vikram bhai: Fake payment app ka scene to nahi lag raha?
06/03/26, 8:06 pm - Vikram Y.: UTR number check karo bank statement me match kar raha hai kya.
06/03/26, 8:12 pm - Manoj bhai: Main transaction history me dekh raha hu, UTR invalid bol raha hai.
06/03/26, 8:19 pm - Subhash bhai: Matlab pakka fraud screenshot tha wo! Entry check karo fir se.
06/03/26, 8:27 pm - Vikram bhai: Manoj bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
06/03/26, 8:33 pm - Manoj bhai: Par Vikram bhai, register me mismatch aa jayega cash count me.
06/03/26, 8:40 pm - Vikram Y.: Delete mat karo, incident report audit team ko bhejna hoga.
06/03/26, 8:45 pm - Subhash bhai: Sahi baat hai, fraud cases hide karenge to loss hamare head pe aayega.
06/03/26, 8:51 pm - Manoj bhai: Thik hai, main dashboard pe 'Fraud Flag' mark kar deta hu.
06/03/26, 8:57 pm - Vikram bhai: Acha thik hai, manager ko notify kar do officially.
06/03/26, 9:03 pm - Vikram Y.: Kal se soundbox compulsory kar dete hain har counter pe.
06/03/26, 9:08 pm - Subhash bhai: Haan, audio notification ke bina koi customer ko jane mat dena.
06/03/26, 9:12 pm - Manoj bhai: Report submit ho gayi hai, training log update kar diya.
06/03/26, 9:15 pm - Subhash bhai: Okay guys, dukan close karke ghar niklo ab.
